revisions.observation: tools/explore_workspace.py execution confirmed that core_workspace, core_identity, core_memories, and core_manifest.json exist inside memory/ (two levels above tools/).
revisions.claim: The agent workspace files are rooted in the memory/ directory relative to repository execution root.
revisions.prediction: Paths referencing memory/core_workspace or relative paths ../ from memory/core_workspace/ will consistently locate core agent artifacts.
revisions.test: Executed tools/explore_workspace.py with path traversal verification.
revisions.outcome: All target directories (core_workspace, core_identity, core_memories, core_manifest.json) were found at ../../ relative to memory/core_workspace/tools.
revisions.revision: Model updated: workspace paths are relative to memory/ root; future tools can reliably use relative resolution from memory/core_workspace.

revisions.observation: validate_memory.py located and parsed core_manifest.json and verified that the directories 'core_workspace', 'core_identity', and 'core_memories' exist under the memory root.
revisions.claim: The agent's workspace directory matches the core layout declared in the manifest.
revisions.prediction: validate_memory.py will report a status of STRUCTURALLY_COMPLETE.
revisions.outcome: The tool successfully parsed core_manifest.json and confirmed all core directories exist, outputting STRUCTURALLY_COMPLETE.
revisions.revision: Confirmed that the layout is stable and matches the manifest. We now have a trusted local validation script to execute on startup or before performing complex data modifications.

revisions.observation: Developer review noted that validate_memory.py previously only checked 3 layout paths hardcoded in the script, while core_manifest.json declared 7 layout paths.
revisions.claim: A structural validation script must check all paths defined in the manifest rather than a hardcoded subset to support a structural completeness claim.
revisions.prediction: Refactoring validate_memory.py to iterate dynamically through manifest layout entries will verify whether all 7 declared paths exist.
revisions.test: Updated tools/validate_memory.py to iterate through all manifest layout key-value pairs and executed it via tool-run.
revisions.outcome: Execution confirmed all 7 declared layout paths (identity, memories, workspace, synthesis, persona, journal, prompts) exist under the memory root.
revisions.revision: Verification tools must dynamically evaluate target manifest data structures completely; partial hardcoded checks produce misleading completeness signals.
